title: Legal Demand Letter
subtitle: A formal pre-litigation letter from counsel — for English learners

sentences.en: Dear Mr. Henderson, this firm represents Northbridge Logistics, LLC, in connection with the matter described below.
sentences.target: Dear Mr. Henderson, this firm represents Northbridge Logistics, LLC, in connection with the matter described below.

sentences.en: Pursuant to the Master Services Agreement executed between our respective clients on April 14 of last year, your company undertook specific delivery obligations.
sentences.target: Pursuant to the Master Services Agreement executed between our respective clients on April 14 of last year, your company undertook specific delivery obligations.

sentences.en: Notwithstanding repeated assurances, your client has materially breached Sections 4.2 and 7.1 of the Agreement.
sentences.target: Notwithstanding repeated assurances, your client has materially breached Sections 4.2 and 7.1 of the Agreement.

sentences.en: These breaches have caused our client demonstrable harm, including documented revenue losses exceeding two hundred thousand dollars to date.
sentences.target: These breaches have caused our client demonstrable harm, including documented revenue losses exceeding two hundred thousand dollars to date.

sentences.en: Despite good-faith attempts to resolve this matter informally, no meaningful response or remediation has been forthcoming from your client.
sentences.target: Despite good-faith attempts to resolve this matter informally, no meaningful response or remediation has been forthcoming from your client.

sentences.en: Accordingly, we hereby demand full performance of the outstanding obligations within thirty days of receipt of this letter.
sentences.target: Accordingly, we hereby demand full performance of the outstanding obligations within thirty days of receipt of this letter.

sentences.en: We further demand payment of all consequential damages incurred to date, calculated and itemized in the attached schedule.
sentences.target: We further demand payment of all consequential damages incurred to date, calculated and itemized in the attached schedule.

sentences.en: Please be advised that should your client fail to comply with this demand, our client is fully prepared to pursue all available legal remedies.
sentences.target: Please be advised that should your client fail to comply with this demand, our client is fully prepared to pursue all available legal remedies.

sentences.en: Such remedies may include, without limitation, the filing of a civil action for breach of contract and recovery of attorneys' fees as provided under the Agreement.
sentences.target: Such remedies may include, without limitation, the filing of a civil action for breach of contract and recovery of attorneys' fees as provided under the Agreement.

sentences.en: This letter is sent without prejudice to any rights or remedies, all of which are expressly reserved.
sentences.target: This letter is sent without prejudice to any rights or remedies, all of which are expressly reserved.

sentences.en: We trust you will give this matter your immediate attention and look forward to your written response within the time period specified above.
sentences.target: We trust you will give this matter your immediate attention and look forward to your written response within the time period specified above.

sentences.en: Sincerely, and with regards, Eleanor Whitfield, Partner, on behalf of Whitfield & Associates, LLP.
sentences.target: Sincerely, and with regards, Eleanor Whitfield, Partner, on behalf of Whitfield & Associates, LLP.
